title: Universal Mind pilot
design: Single-arm feasibility pilot with repeated before-and-after observations
briefing: This pilot explores how a ten-minute electronic music television experience relates to hypothesised short term stress reduction and increased connection. It brings together EMDR, brain entrainment and sub-audible mantra. Findings will help inform future research with young female veterans. Thank you for your valued service today.
requirements: You’ll need a laptop with a working camera, internet, a Bluetooth speaker and three sessions over one week. You can stop at any time.
eligibility: Women aged 18 and over, recruited through personal networks. This first pilot does not require veteran status.

experience.implementation: Existing M8 experience and existing brain entrainment profile; no new sound generator.

analysis.hrv_psd: Exploratory one-minute beat-interval power around 0.1 Hz (0.085–0.115 Hz), with the spectrum and quality retained. Not a HeartMath score or direct baroreflex sensitivity measurement.
analysis.change: 100 * (after - before) / before; unavailable when baseline is zero or either value is missing

compensation_rule: 100 AUD after all three sessions are completed; otherwise zero.
